Awards various titles and a unique weapon skin when completed.

name: 15th Year Anniversary Celebrations
description:
Earned by completing opposed missions during the 15 years of APB event!

Awards unique Titles and Joker Tickets.

Level 1:
Here Since Day One Title
150 Joker Tickets
Level 2:
Caked Up Title
300 Joker Tickets
Level 3:
OG AF Title

name: Anarchy - Score Streak 1
description:
Earned by gaining a score of 500 during one life in the Anarchy Event.

Awards 150 Joker Tickets.

name: Anarchy - Score Streak 2
description:
Earned by gaining a score of 1000 during one life in the Anarchy Event.

Awards 350 Joker Tickets.

name: Anarchy - Score Streak 3
description:
Earned by gaining a score of 1500 during one life in the Anarchy Event.

Awards a one-off 10-Day lease of the Nekrova Squad Support Weapon.

name: Arsonist
description:
Advanced by Performing Arsons. 
Provides Petrol Can upgrades.

Awards the 'Arsonist' title when Maxed.

name: Back in the Streets
description:
Earned by completing missions as a token of appreciation for your patience during APB downtime.

Awards unique Titles and Joker Tickets.

Level 1:
Back In The Streets Title
500 Joker Tickets
Level 2:
Connecting to World Server Title
